Summary On November 5, several areas in Puncak Alam, Selangor, experienced flash floods due to prolonged heavy rain, leading to road inundations and an overflowing flood retention pond in Taman Seri Alam.
 Affected locations included Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM) Puncak Alam and Jalan Meru.
 The Malaysian Meteorological Department had forecast thunderstorms in the region, but the extent of the impact, including the number of affected individuals and specific emergencies, had not been confirmed.
 Make Malay Mail your preferred source on Google Giving you news that matter to Malaysians. Make Malay Mail your preferred source when you search for news on Google. By Malay Mail First Published: Thursday, 05 Nov 2026 8:03 PM MYT × Subscribe to Newsletter
 Subscribe KUALA LUMPUR, Nov 5 — Several areas around Puncak Alam, Selangor, were hit by flash floods this afternoon following prolonged heavy rain, leaving several roads inundated.
 Malay Mail also sighted an overflowing flood retention pond at Taman Seri Alam in Saujana Utama, Sungai Buloh, with water gushing into a nearby residential area.
 According to Harian Metro , other affected areas included Universiti Teknologi MARA (UiTM) Puncak Alam, Alam Suria and Jalan Meru near the Kampung Bukit Cerakah junction.
 https://www.dailymotion.com/video/xbtw6zq Videos of the incident showed muddy floodwaters covering roads and a parking area near UiTM Puncak Alam, while photographs showed vehicles making their way through flooded roads.
 Heavy rain reportedly continued in Puncak Alam until around 5pm.
 Vehicles travel along a road affected by flash floods at Bandar Hillpark in Puncak Alam following heavy rain on November 5, 2026. — Picture by Yusof Isa 
 The Malaysian Meteorological Department (MetMalaysia) had forecast thunderstorms across much of Selangor this afternoon and evening, including in Kuala Selangor.
 As of the report, authorities had yet to confirm the number of people affected, road conditions or whether any emergencies had occurred.
